Input_Format: Raw JSON/JSONL corpus from Indian Courts and Acts
Cleaning_Filtering_Rules: Tribunals downsampled to 10%; dropped docs with non-ASCII control >0.1% or ? >5%; stripped Devanagari script regex [\u0900-\u097F]; dropped 0-length documents; High Courts excluded 100% due to severe OCR noise
Tokenization_Vocabulary: Custom Byte-Level BPE tokenizer, vocabulary size 40,000 (<pad>=0, <bos>=1, <eos>=2)
Chunking_Slicing_Strategy: Sequential packing into binary uint16 token streams (acts_train.bin, sc_train.bin, tribunals_train_f.bin); packed sequences up to 1024/2048 tokens

Input_Format: Nested JSON with document ID, character text, and gold entity tuples [start, end, label, text]
Cleaning_Filtering_Rules: Whitespace normalization; character offset alignment audit across 70 train docs (8,393 entities); resolution of leading-whitespace BPE artifact via correct_offsets()
Tokenization_Vocabulary: Byte-Level BPE (40,000 vocab); subword tokenization with offset mapping
Chunking_Slicing_Strategy: Sliding window of 512 tokens with 256-token overlap / stride
Offset_Label_Preservation: Exact character-to-token span mapping with 25-class BIO tag scheme; 153 boundary adjustments (81 PREC, 24 STAT, 18 COURT, 14 AUTH, etc.); 98.18% strict span recoverability

Input_Format: JSON containing case ID, sentence lists (text), and corresponding rhetorical role labels
Cleaning_Filtering_Rules: Retained all legal sentences; segregated analysis between Corporate Law (CL) and Income Tax (IT); handled extreme rare classes (PrecedentOverruled = 3 instances, Dissent = 284 in CL only)
Chunking_Slicing_Strategy: Sentence-level classification with preceding/succeeding context windows (or individual pooled sentence tokens)
Offset_Label_Preservation: Sentence index mapped to 13 discrete rhetorical role categories (0 to 12); verified no label leakage across train/dev splits

Input_Format: JSON with case ID and full judicial text; binary label (0: Dismissed, 1: Allowed)
Cleaning_Filtering_Rules: Whitespace normalization; lowercasing for TF-IDF backbones; preservation of outcome-bearing holdings in final sentences
Tokenization_Vocabulary: Byte-Level BPE (40,000 vocab) + word/char n-gram vectorizers (100k features)
Chunking_Slicing_Strategy: Hierarchical 4-Zone Slicing: Head (384/256 tok), Mid-1 (384/256 tok), Mid-2 (384/256 tok), Tail (384/256 tok); total 1,536 or 1,024 tokens fed into cross-zone attention transformer
Offset_Label_Preservation: Binary document-level classification label retained; balanced development set (994/994) for leak-free threshold calibration

Input_Format: JSON with document ID, text containing <SECTION> and <ACT> anonymization tags, and target integer statute labels
Cleaning_Filtering_Rules: Standardized anonymized entity tags; filtered non-printable characters
Chunking_Slicing_Strategy: Dual-View Pre-Tokenization: Head zone (statutory charges/preamble) + Tail zone (dispositive citations/holding) at 256/384 tokens per zone
Offset_Label_Preservation: 100-dimensional binary multi-hot target vector; per-statute threshold calibration on development set (10,181 docs)

Input_Format: JSON pairs with document ID, full judgment text (document), and reference gold summary (summary)
Cleaning_Filtering_Rules: Filtered 1 malformed pair with 0-length summary in training set (6,678 -> 6,677 clean); normalized punctuation and whitespace
Chunking_Slicing_Strategy: Input document truncated to 1,024 tokens; generation restricted to maximum 512 tokens with repetition penalties
Offset_Label_Preservation: Paired sequence-to-sequence input/target mapping for causal decoder and encoder-decoder backbones

Input_Format: JSON query documents (sentence lists) and corresponding candidate pool JSON files (train, dev, test)
Cleaning_Filtering_Rules: Concatenation of sentence lists into complete document strings; lowercasing; regex legal citation extraction
Tokenization_Vocabulary: Byte-Level BPE (40,000 vocab) + word unigram-bigram-trigram TF-IDF (100,000 features) + Okapi BM25
Chunking_Slicing_Strategy: Full document ingestion without truncation into sparse matrix representations; no arbitrary truncation of precedent cases
Offset_Label_Preservation: Strict ranking of candidate IDs; Top-7 reciprocal graph diffusion; verification of candidate membership within official split pool
